findings.source: Mathematics Stack Exchange — When does (a,b) -> (2a,b-a) terminate?
findings.relationship: Same update rule; after gcd reduction, answer states termination iff p+q=2^m.
findings.notes: This is exactly equivalent to (a+b)/gcd(a,b) being a power of two.
